ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is the x-axis, and the vertical axis is the electric field strength E. The E-x curve passes through the origin O; on the side x>0, the curve is above the x-axis, that is, E is positive; on the side x<0, the curve is below the x-axis, that is, E is negative. The shape on the left and right sides of the figure is oddly symmetric about the origin. The marked x1 and -x1 are two points on the x-axis symmetric about the origin, so the electric field strengths at the two points are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction. Then reason: In item A, if comparing the magnitude of the field strength, the magnitudes at x1 and -x1 are equal, not that the one at x1 is greater, so A is wrong. An electron is released from rest at x1, and the work done by the electric field force is W=q∫E dx. Since E(x) is an odd function about the origin, ∫E dx=0 on the symmetric interval [-x1,x1]; the integral from x1 to -x1 is also 0. Therefore the total work done by the electric field force on the electron is 0, the initial kinetic energy is 0, and the final kinetic energy is still 0, so when it reaches point -x1 its speed is zero, so B is correct. The potential difference satisfies φ(x1)-φ(-x1)=-∫_{-x1}^{x1}E dx=0, so the potentials at the two points are equal, and D is wrong. The electric potential energy of an electron is Ep=qφ. Since the potentials at the two points are equal, the electric potential energies of the electron at the two points are equal, and C is wrong.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出：E-x图线过原点，右侧x>0处E为正、左侧x<0处E为负，且关于原点呈奇对称形态；标出的x1与-x1关于原点对称，因此两点处场强大小相等、方向相反。从文字读出：需判断A-D，尤其涉及电子从x1静止释放到-x1以及电势、电势能比较。关键桥梁：电场力做功等于电荷量乘以沿路径的电场面积积分，W=q∫E dx；奇函数在对称区间[-x1,x1]上的积分为0。因此从x1到-x1，∫E dx=0，电子所受电场力总功为0，初动能为0则末动能仍为0，所以到达-x1时速度为零，B正确。并据此排除：A因两点场强大小相等而错；电势差U=-∫E dx=0，故D错；电子电势能qφ相等，故C错。

raw_record.original_question:
(2015·盐城质检)空间有一沿x轴对称分布的电场,其电场强度E随x变化的图象如图所示,x1和-x1为x轴上对称的两点.下列说法正确的是( )
A. x1处场强大于-x1处场强
B. 若电子从x1处由静止释放后向x轴负方向运动,到达-x1点时速度为零
C. 电子在x1处的电势能大于在-x1处的电势能
D. x1点的电势比-x1点的电势高
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis is the x-axis, and the vertical axis is the electric field strength E. The E-x curve passes through the origin O; on the side x>0, the curve is above the x-axis, that is, E is positive; on the side x<0, the curve is below the x-axis, that is, E is negative. The shape on the left and right sides of the figure is oddly symmetric about the origin. The marked x1 and -x1 are two points on the x-axis symmetric about the origin, so the electric field strengths at the two points are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction. Then reason: In item A, if comparing the magnitude of the field strength, the magnitudes at x1 and -x1 are equal, not that the one at x1 is greater, so A is wrong. An electron is released from rest at x1, and the work done by the electric field force is W=q∫E dx. Since E(x) is an odd function about the origin, ∫E dx=0 on the symmetric interval [-x1,x1]; the integral from x1 to -x1 is also 0. Therefore the total work done by the electric field force on the electron is 0, the initial kinetic energy is 0, and the final kinetic energy is still 0, so when it reaches point -x1 its speed is zero, so B is correct. The potential difference satisfies φ(x1)-φ(-x1)=-∫_{-x1}^{x1}E dx=0, so the potentials at the two points are equal, and D is wrong. The electric potential energy of an electron is Ep=qφ. Since the potentials at the two points are equal, the electric potential energies of the electron at the two points are equal, and C is wrong.

critic_agent_reviews.critic_suggestions: 推理链符合题意、图像信息和标准答案。图像描述在前、物理推理在后，顺序满足要求。可微调之处：A项中“场强大小相等”与选项“场强大于”应明确选项若按电场强度代数值比较，右侧E为正、左侧E为负则x1处代数值确实大于-x1处；但高中语境中“场强”常指大小，且方法草案按大小判断。若要更严谨，可写为“若指场强大小，两点大小相等；若指E的代数值，则图像显示符号相反，但选项语境通常比较场强大小”。不过根据标准答案B和方法草案，候选推理可接受。
整体推理正确，符合标准答案B，也基本完全遵循方法草案；图像描述先于推理，视觉依据与图像一致。可小幅改进之处：在否定A时明确“场强大于”按场强大小理解，而不是按E的带符号分量比较，以避免歧义。

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
(2015·Yancheng Quality Inspection) In space there is an electric field symmetrically distributed along the x-axis. The graph of its electric field strength E varying with x is shown in the figure. x1 and -x1 are two symmetric points on the x-axis. Which of the following statements is correct? ( )
A. The field strength at x1 is greater than the field strength at -x1
B. If an electron is released from rest at x1 and then moves in the negative direction of the x-axis, its speed is zero when it reaches -x1
C. The electric potential energy of the electron at x1 is greater than that at -x1
D. The electric potential at point x1 is higher than that at point -x1
